Class AzureServiceBusReceiverBase<TBody, TConsumer>

Namespace
NuvTools.Notification.Messaging.Azure.ServiceBus
Assembly
NuvTools.Notification.Messaging.Azure.ServiceBus.dll

Abstract base class for Azure Service Bus receivers, containing shared message processing logic. The type of the message body to deserialize and process. The consumer type that implements IMessageConsumer<TBody> and handles the message. 

public abstract class AzureServiceBusReceiverBase<TBody, TConsumer> : BackgroundService, IHostedService, IDisposable where TBody : class where TConsumer : IMessageConsumer<TBody>
